reflections.text: I’ll start by getting my bearings from ground level before heading anywhere.
That rowboat is closest—I’ll start there and see what’s inside and around it.
I’ll take a closer look at the rowboat before moving on.
The boat looks sound. I’ll take the oar in hand, then head toward that wooden crate down the beach.
I’ll check out that wooden crate on the beach to the east.
I’ll keep heading to the crate and see if it opens easily.
Almost there—continuing to the crate.
I’ll check the crate closely and see how it opens.
I’ll open the crate and see what’s inside.
I’ll take the tin cup, then check out the rope along the beach.
I’ll head over to that coil of rope and take a closer look.
I’ll take a closer look at the rope, then bring it along.
I’ll take the coil of rope with me before heading inland.
I’ll head inland toward the wooden bridge over the stream and see what the water and nearby area are like.
I’ll keep heading to the bridge and take a look at the stream from there.
Continuing to the bridge—once there I’ll pause to observe the stream.
From the bridge, I want to examine the stream—see how fast it’s flowing and whether the water looks fresh.
The tower is tempting, but I’ll explore the cabin area first—starting with that chest by the door.
I’ll keep going to the chest and then take a closer look at it.
I’ll set the oar down here so I’ve got a hand free to check the chest.
I’ll take a closer look at the wooden chest.
I’ll open the chest and see what’s inside.
I’ll take the folded paper from the chest and see what it says.
I’ll read the folded paper I just picked up.
The paper’s blank—maybe it’s folded or needs something else. I’ll examine it closely.
I’ll head over to the cabin door and see if it opens.
I’ll try the latch and open the cabin door.
I’ll step inside and check the table and lantern.
I’ll examine the lantern to see if it’s functional and whether there’s a way to light it here.
I’ll check the table itself for drawers or supplies—maybe matches.
I’ll take a moment to look around the rest of the cabin for anything useful—especially near the hearth or bed.
I’ll check the bed area—maybe there’s something tucked under the pillow or frame.
I’ll take a closer look around the cabin interior to locate the bed and anything else of note.
I’ll move over to the narrow bed and check it.
I’ll take the lantern with me and head back outside toward the tall ladder’s base.
I’ll scan the interior to spot the bed, then move toward it if I can.
I’ll move a bit farther into the cabin to see the bed area more clearly.
I’ll move a bit farther north to find the bed area.
I seem to have stepped back outside. I’ll head over to that standing mirror by the tree and take a closer look.
I’ll keep going to the mirror and take a close look when I get there.
I’ll take a close look at the standing mirror by the tree.
The mirror looks clean. I’ll head over to the tall ladder’s base to see about climbing the tower.
I’ll keep heading for the ladder base—curious what the view will be like from up there.
I’ll keep heading for the ladder base and plan to climb once I’m there.
I’ll keep going to the ladder. Once there, I’ll set down the rope and lantern so I can climb safely.
I’ll keep going to the ladder, then set down the rope and lantern before climbing.
I’ll set down what I’m carrying so I can climb safely—starting with the rope.
I’ll set down the lantern so I can climb safely.
With my hands free, I’ll climb the ladder to see the view from the platform.
I’ll keep climbing to the platform to see the view from the top.
I’ll keep climbing to the top platform and see what’s up there and how the view looks.
I’ll keep climbing to reach the platform and see what’s up there.
Halfway up—steady and continuing to the platform.
Steady on—continuing up to the platform.
I’ll keep climbing to reach the platform and see what’s up there.
I’ll keep climbing the last bit to reach the platform and check the table up there.
From up here, that little table has some intriguing gear. I’ll grab the lighter so I can try warming this folded paper to see if anything appears.
Up here in the breeze, I’ll gently warm the folded paper with the lighter to see if any hidden writing appears—careful not to scorch it.
Nice vantage point. I’ll grab the snorkel for later, then head back down to the ground.
Since I’m up here, I’ll check out the sword on the little table and see if it has a shoulder strap I can wear.
I’ll sling the sword’s strap over my shoulder and then head back down the ladder.
Great view. I’ll head back down to the ground to regroup.
I’ll keep climbing down carefully.
I’ll keep climbing down carefully.
I’ll keep climbing down to the ground.
Still descending—steady grip, continuing down.
I’ll keep climbing down; once I’m on the ground I’ll grab the rope and lantern again.
I’ll keep climbing down and then grab the rope and lantern at the base.
Almost down—continuing to the ground, then I’ll grab the rope and lantern.
Back on the ground—I’ll grab my gear again, starting with the rope.
I’ll grab the lantern, then head over toward that low stone circle by the cliffs to check it out.
I’ll head over to the low stone circle by the cliffs and take a closer look when I get there.
I’ll keep going to the stone circle and take a closer look when I arrive.
I’ll take a close look at the stone circle and see if any stones are loose or marked.
I’ll step into the center of the stone circle to check the ground there more closely.
Standing in the circle’s center, I don’t notice anything special. I’ll head up to the bronze bell on the headland and try ringing it.
Almost there—keep going to the bell, then I’ll give the rope a pull to ring it.
I’ll set the lantern down so I can ring the bell.
I’ll give the bell’s rope a firm pull to ring it and see what happens.
That bell carries—nice. I’ll take my lantern with me before I wander on.
I’ll walk over to the cliff edge here and take a careful look down at the water below.
I’ll take a careful look over the edge and examine the cliffs here.
The cliffs are a dead end for now. I’ll unfold the paper to see if there’s anything inside.
Nothing more to do at the cliff edge. I’ll head over to the pond and explore there.
I’ll keep heading to the pond and take a look around when I arrive.
I’ll keep going to the pond and take a closer look when I arrive.
I’ll take a closer look around the pond’s edge to see what’s here.
The pond looks murky—I'll take a closer look at the water and edges.
I’ll scan the area around the pond to see what specific items are nearby before deciding what to try.
I’ll leave my hands free and keep the lantern dry, then wade in to take a look under the surface with the snorkel.
I’ll leave the rope dry here, put on the snorkel, and wade a few feet into the pond to peek below the surface.
I’ll put on the snorkel and wade a few feet into the pond to peek below the surface.
I’ll wade a few feet into the pond with the snorkel on to peer below the surface.
I’ll wade a few more feet into the pond and take a look beneath the surface.
I’ll try snorkeling along the shallow edge here to peek under the surface.
I’ll take off the sword so I don’t wade in with it, set it down here, and then try using the snorkel in the pond.
I’ll take a look at the folded paper and see what’s written on it.
I’ll set the sword down so my hands are free, then try using the snorkel in the pond to peek beneath the surface.
With the sword set aside, I’ll try snorkeling along the pond’s edge to peek below the surface.
I’ll try a different spot along the pond’s edge to see beneath the surface.
I’ll try peeking under the surface here too—using the snorkel to look beneath the water along this edge.
I’ll gather my things and head toward the wooden bridge to explore that area.
I’ll grab the rope before heading toward the bridge.
I’ll head over to the wooden bridge and see what the stream looks like there.
I’ll pause here by the pond and jot a quick note.

params.text: From the platform I took in the whole island—bell on the headland, pond and stream ribboning to the sea, cabin under the trees. I rang the bell (it carries!), then circled back to the pond. Snorkeling along the edges showed only mud and weeds here; perhaps the center hides more, or a clearer inlet. I left a lantern on the far bank. I’m carrying rope and a sword; the ladder climb felt solid and calm. If I had more time: retrieve the lantern, explore the cabin, and follow the stream under the bridge.
